changelog: AI Image Upscaler: Dedicated on-device super-resolution tool with Point 7 models (Real-ESRGAN General 2×/4×, Anime 4×, and native Lanczos/Bicubic/Nearest)
Accurate File Size Estimations: Exact 24-bit padded rowBytes for BMP and precision empirical formulas across all image and video studio formats
Video Studio & Compressor Overhaul: Compression speed presets (Slow, Medium, Fast), video rotation (90°/180°/270°), flip (H/V), 4:3 and 3:4 aspects, and custom margin crop slider
Trim-bounded Playback: Live media player playback, seeking, and scrubber looping strictly clamped to selected trim interval
Scale > 100% Live Preview: Real-time visual scaling reflection and memory-safe full-resolution export for enlarged image studio scaling
On-Demand Model Manager: In-app model repository with background download, SHA-256 integrity verification, and zero initial APK bloat
